exposure: Diabetes Mellitus (DM) status during pregnancy (pre-existing DM, gestational DM, neither)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 309,825 women with at least 1 live newborn born between January 01, 2005 and September 30, 2014, resulting in 469,150 birth events and 477,089 live newborns.
finding: The incidence of PPCM in Alberta, Canada was approximately 1/2400 births and was higher in pregnancies in women with pre-existing or gestational diabetes mellitus compared to those without.
